About

Nations Cup is a two-day Free-for-All (FFA) tournament organised by the Openfront Hub staff.

Created and organized as a way to determine what is the best country in Openfront, the FFA serves as qualification in order to create teams for each nation.

Format

General

  • Game Mode: Free-for-All (FFA)
  • Players: 80
  • Dates: April 11th and 12th

Map Rotation

The following 5 maps were played in this exact rotation on each matchday:

  • Two Lakes
  • Arctic
  • Africa
  • Europe
  • Giant World Map

Qualification System

Players by performing well in the FFAs can qualify for the Final by being selected to represent their country in Trios. The following teams that will be created are as follows:

  • United States
  • United Kingdom
  • France
  • European Union
  • Rest of the World

Rankings of the FFAs will be determined by maximum size reached at any point of the game.

There will be 2 days of FFAs with 5 games each lasting 20 minutes.

Rules

  • No teaming
  • No ruination
  • No toxicity
  • No spawn killing
  • No MIRVs
